decision: Use one shared Qwen-compatible model endpoint for logical agents.
Never expose unrestricted shell or unrestricted SQL as tools.
Use deterministic verification as the success gate.
Implement inspect_vector as the only executable skill in Checkpoint 1.
Use an external Docker-managed named volume for persistent PostGIS storage and attach PostGIS declaratively to both the GeoServer default network and geoagent-backend.
Implement PostGIS validation as a deterministic read-only verifier, separate from LLM agents, using fixed SQL and validated identifiers.
Derive final workflow success exclusively from deterministic PostGIS validation and generate a secret-redacted JSON trace and Markdown report for every completed workflow.
Verify report and trace roots are writable before any database execution and block all artifact overwrites.
